construction.implementation_origin: Original, self-contained Python implementation created for this isolated build.

input.work_orders: ERP/MES-style JSON list: id, asset_id, product, description, status, tolerances, maintenance_logs
input.sensor_csv: Embedded time-series CSV with exact header: id,timestamp,asset_id,work_order_id,metric,value,unit,safety_critical
input.quality_inspections: JSON list: id, work_order_id, asset_id, timestamp, decision, decided_by, rationale, measurements

shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, fixture_label, query, results (document plus score), alerts, index, constraint_notice
shared_schema.units_and_tolerances: Exact units: temperature C, vibration mm/s, pressure bar, diameter mm. No implicit unit conversion. Finite numeric min <= max within demonstrative physical bounds, inclusive endpoints. Each measurement requires the corresponding work-order tolerance.
shared_schema.timestamps: ISO 8601 with timezone. Input ordering is not required; document IDs provide deterministic tie breaks.
shared_schema.quality_traceability: Decision author, timestamp, rationale, measurement evidence, asset/work-order linkage and applicable tolerance snapshot are mandatory and retained in the result. A pass cannot contradict measured tolerances. Demonstrative ISO 9001-inspired traceability only, not certification.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single semantic-search functionality: the shared validator parses all entity sources into common documents and independently collected human-review alerts.
Validated documents feed an in-memory inverted index; canonical domain synonyms feed BM25 ranking.
Optional injected local embedding callable accepts [query, *document_texts]. Returned vectors are validated before cosine reranking.
Ranked common document envelopes retain source evidence and tolerance snapshots; alerts survive no-match queries and top-k truncation.

behavior.ranking: BM25 (k1=1.2, b=0.75), score/(1+score); optional 0.7 lexical + 0.3 nonnegative cosine. Descending score, ascending unique ID tie break, positive-score matches only.
behavior.embedding_contract: Optional run(payload, embed=callable) only; one finite nonzero vector per input, identical dimensions 1..4096; no live provider. Callable determinism is the caller's responsibility.
behavior.human_escalation: Every explicitly safety-critical reading produces pending_human_review routed to human_safety_operator even when in tolerance. Other out-of-tolerance readings route to human_quality_reviewer. No automatic machine action and no claim of delivered notification.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled synthetic assets, work orders and invented maintenance history. Tests generate physically plausible randomized temperature readings with fixed random seed 149.
behavior.validation: Strict JSON object shapes, unique record IDs, existing work-order links, asset match, timezone timestamps, finite physical values, exact CSV header, unit and tolerance checks. CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard numeric constants.
behavior.bounds: 1000 work orders, 1000 inspections, 10000 sensor rows, 2000000 CSV characters, 100 logs/order, 100 measurements/inspection.
behavior.determinism: No wall-clock dependency, random ranking, live model call, network connection, or persisted index. Input is not mutated.

excluded: Actual safety control or human notification delivery
Learning or fitting a semantic model

test_outcomes.cli: passed: one JSON object on stdout, status ok
coverage: Domain synonyms and all three entity types
Quality-decision evidence and contradictory pass rejection
Safety-critical human escalation independent of query and result limits
Empty index, no matches, inclusive tolerance boundaries and top-k
Invalid schema, units, tolerance ranges, numeric values, CSV and references
Injected embedding retrieval, malformed vectors and callable failures
CLI success, usage errors, missing file, malformed JSON and input validation
